title: Ensure AAP Inventory with Hosts
description: Ensures an AAP organization and inventory exist, then adds all specified hosts to the inventory, reporting per-host success/failure.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: aap_gateway_ip
parameters.description: The IP address or hostname of the AAP controller gateway.

parameters.name: aap_user
parameters.description: Username for authenticating to the AAP controller API.

parameters.name: aap_password
parameters.description: Password for authenticating to the AAP controller API.

parameters.name: organization_name
parameters.description: The name of the AAP organization to ensure exists.

parameters.name: inventory_name
parameters.description: The name of the AAP inventory to ensure exists within the organization.

parameters.name: hosts_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of host names to ensure present in the inventory.

playbook_output.description: Emits organization_name, inventory_name, added_hosts, and failed_hosts.

fields.name: organization_name
fields.description: The name of the AAP organization.

fields.name: inventory_name
fields.description: The name of the AAP inventory.

fields.name: added_hosts
fields.description: List of host names that were successfully added to the inventory.

fields.name: failed_hosts
fields.description: List of host names that failed to be added to the inventory.

steps.name: Look up existing organization
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for an organization matching the given name.

steps.name: Does the organization already exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether step-01's lookup found a matching organization.
steps.condition: The organization lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Create the organization
steps.function: Create the organization using the idempotent ansible.controller.organization module.

steps.name: Does the inventory already exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether the inventory lookup found a matching inventory in the given organization.
steps.condition: The inventory lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Create the inventory
steps.function: Create the inventory using the idempotent ansible.controller.inventory module.

steps.name: Add hosts to the inventory
steps.function: Loop through the comma-separated hosts_list and add each host to the inventory using the idempotent ansible.controller.host module, recording per-host success and failure.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Look up the organization and inventory to determine what needs to be created.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Create the organization and inventory if missing, then add all hosts to the inventory.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final result to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
